name: Idaho

jury_list.statute: Idaho Code 2-213(4): the contents of records or papers used by the jury commissioner or clerk in the selection process, and not made public under 2-206(5), 'shall not be disclosed' except for a jury-selection motion. 2-208(1): neither the names drawn nor the list shall be disclosed except on order of the presiding judge. 2-208(7): questionnaire contents are confidential as provided by Supreme Court rule.
jury_list.holder: County jury commission / clerk of the district court.

sources.cite: Idaho Code 2-208 (qualification questionnaire asks about citizenship; names drawn not disclosed; contents confidential per court rule)

voter_file.who_may_get: Any individual, from the county clerk, at reproduction cost (Idaho Code 34-437(1)). The list holds names and addresses by precinct.
voter_file.permitted_uses: Not for mailing or delivering advertisements, offers, or solicitations for money or anything of value; any political purpose is allowed (34-437(2)).

private_challenge.who: At the time of an election, any registered elector may challenge an entry in the election register by noting the reason and signing (Idaho Code 34-431). The county clerk follows up after the election (34-432). No pre-election written challenge by a private elector was found.
private_challenge.form_or_statute: Idaho Code 34-431, 34-432. Not supported by JuryRoll.

sources.cite: Idaho Code 34-432 (post-election clerk inquiry; clerk may inquire into any registration at any time)

county_board.name: Idaho county clerks (VoteIdaho.gov)
county_board.note: The county clerk must suspend a registration that appears from the clerk's records not to be a citizen's (Idaho Code 34-419).

ag.name: Idaho Office of the Attorney General

gates.basis: Juror selection records may not be disclosed (Idaho Code 2-213(4), 2-208). The only private challenge is at the time of an election (34-431). Strict gates: counts only.

notes: official_pipeline is null: no jury-to-clerk non-citizen statute was found. Idaho Code 34-419 tells the county clerk to suspend any registration that appears, from the clerk's own records, not to be a citizen's.
dob_in_public_file and registration_date_in_public_file are null: 34-437 lists names and addresses only and does not address other fields.
